Hi Daniel — thanks for the files and the clear flags. Looping in Jordan (contracts) and Kimberly (security & hosting) so we can triage internally prior to a sync. Quick notes from a first read:

- Data residency request (US-only): feasible on Redwood Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we need to confirm region pin. Kimberly, can you advise on a standard residency commitment and what additional paperwork we need?
- Indemnity carveouts: Jordan, see Crownline's proposed redline in Section 9 — appears broader than our template. Recommend we propose a mutual indemnity with a carve-in for third-party connectors limited to proven breaches.
- SLA target: 99.5% is higher than our standard hosted SLA. Ops can entertain it on Dedicated with a capacity commitment.

Daniel — to keep momentum, can you do Wed 1/14 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 1/15 13:00–13:30 PT? If either works we'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,

Thanks Olga — I reviewed Crownline's marked draft. A few specific suggestions I’ll bring to the call:

1) Counterproposal language for Section 9 (Indemnity): suggest mutual indemnity with an explicit cap tied to paid fees over the 12 months preceding the claim; state-specific carveouts should be redlined off.
2) Exhibit A (Order Form): billing contact OK; need buyer PO flow for mid-quarter seat increases — propose a 30-day billing adjustment clause.
3) Signature block & execution: Crownline has an appendix for delegated signatories — ask for confirmation of signatory names and a sample KYC if required.

I can take point on drafting the redline for the indemnity and the billing adjustment item after the sync.
